accept_rush.text: That's what I like to hear! Get me there in under 45 seconds and I'll throw in a $300 hazard bonus!

accept_standard.text: Much appreciated. Let's head for Financial Plaza — please keep the ride steady!

decline.text: Unbelievable! Good help is impossible to find in this metropolis...

choices.label: Buckle up, Marcus! We're taking the express route. (+Rush Bonus)
Hop in, I'll get you there safely and smoothly.
Sorry pal, I'm off duty right now.

start.text: Driver, thank goodness! I have a board meeting at the Financial Plaza in less than a minute. If I'm late, the merger falls apart!

accept_dj.text: Legendary! Follow the glowing waypoint pillar. Let's make some noise!

decline.text: Aww man, the crowd is gonna be waiting...

choices.label: Let's turn up the bass and blast across the city!
Can't take you right now, Lyra.

start.text: Yo driver! My headlining set at the Neon Club starts soon and I've got my custom synth deck in the trunk. Ready to roll?

accept_science.text: Excellent. Keep your eyes on the road and let's get moving!

decline.text: Very well. I will find another courier.

choices.label: Understood, Doctor. Full throttle to the Tech Labs.
Sounds too risky for me.

start.text: Keep your voice down... Quantum Dynamics stole Aether Skyspire's atmospheric-energy model. This drive proves it. We must cross the bridge to Advanced Tech Labs immediately.

decline.text: Oh, no worries at all. Have a nice day!

choices.label: With pleasure! Welcome to MetroPulse 3D.
Sorry, not taking fares right now.

start.text: Hello! I'm visiting MetroPulse to admire the skyscrapers. Could you take me to the Central Spire in the heart of downtown?

accept_normal.text: Understood. Safe travels, get on scene as soon as you can.

accept_sirens.text: Cruiser dispatched! Watch out for traffic. Intercept the suspects!

choices.label: Sirens on! I am responding at high speed. (+Rush Bonus)
Copy that, proceeding carefully to coordinates.
Unable to assist, dispatch. Other duty.

start.text: Officer, we have a Code 3! A bank heist is underway at the Apex Bank Plaza! Get there immediately to block the exit routes!

missions.sabotageAction: Jam the getaway fleet's ignition network
missions.title: Bank Heist Response

accept.text: Copy. Secure the perimeter once on site.

decline.text: Understood. Stand by for next assignment.

choices.label: Acknowledged. Moving in to investigate the park area.
Negative, busy with traffic patrol.

start.text: Attention all units, reports of suspicious activity and disturbance near the Central Park North Gate. Investigate code two.

accept_race.text: Timer starts now! GO, GO, GO!

decline.text: Disappointing. We need faster drivers on this team.

choices.label: Let's push this V6 to the limit! Let's go!
Not racing today, my engine is cold.

start.text: Alright racer, the sponsors are watching. Beat this time trial to the Waterfront Harbor and show us what this sports machine can do!

accept_smuggle.text: Good. Dodge the patrols and make it fast.

decline.text: Whatever. I will find a sports driver who isn't chicken.

choices.label: Deal. Out of sight, top speed.
No way, too hot for me.

start.text: Yo. NeoTech intercepted an Orbital Systems data pad tying both firms to the comet-guidance conspiracy. Get it across the bridge to Boba Haven. No police sirens. Interested?

accept.text: Drive safely, operator. Keep it on schedule.

choices.label: Route accepted. Moving to pick up the passengers.
End of shift. Heading to depot.

start.text: Operator, the shuttle schedule is running late! Please complete the Waterfront Route to pick up waiting commuters.

accept.text: Wonderful! Let's show them the skyline.

decline.text: Oh, we will wait for the next scheduled route.

choices.label: All aboard! Let's begin the city tour.
Sorry, bus is full or out of service.

start.text: Welcome bus driver! The tourists are aboard. Please take us safely through the downtown commercial strip to the central hub.

accept.text: Excellent. Keep the speed steady on turns and head to the construction yard.

decline.text: Alright, looking for another freight operator.

choices.label: Engage high gear, I'm on it.
Too heavy for my rig today.

start.text: Hey driver, this truck is loaded with heavy structural steel. We need it delivered to the Construction Yard ASAP. Keep the cargo secure!

accept.text: Awesome. Move quickly before the cooling system fails!

decline.text: No worries, I'll find another dispatcher.

choices.label: Fast express delivery, let's roll.
Not hauling cold goods today.

start.text: The cooling unit in this cargo truck is low on battery. Get these fresh food supplies to Mart 24/7 before they spoil!

accept.text: You are such a sweet soul. Thank you, let's head home!

decline.text: Oh, no problem. I'll ask one of the yellow taxis.

choices.label: Of course, Aunt Sarah! Put them in the trunk, let's go.
Sorry, I am late for another appointment.

start.text: Oh, dear! I have so many heavy grocery bags from the market. Could you give me a lift back home to the West Residential Block?

accept.text: Telemetry log initiated. Safe drive to Nexus Plaza.

choices.label: Ready to log system data.
Calibration error. Not ready.

start.text: Hello, we need a manual diagnostic test drive of this Sedan to Nexus Plaza to check the sensory nodes. Ready to proceed?

accept.text: Comets inbound. Survive for forty-five seconds; every intact shareholder is a victory.

decline.text: Understood. Human resources will note your lack of extinction-event initiative.

choices.label: Start the Mayhem prologue. The quarterly report survives with us.
The apocalypse is outside my compensation band.

start.text: This is the climax, driver. Quantum Dynamics turned the comet-deflection grid into a hostile takeover instrument. Keep this prototype alive until Aether uploads the shutdown key.
